test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Wild goose chase
solution:
The correct answer is __**Futile search.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An Idiom is a collection of words established by usage as having a meaning distinct from the meanings of the individual words.
 
• The meaning of idiom** Wild goose chase** is a senseless and pointless search for or quest of something unachievable.
 
• *Example *: Searching for treasure is a** wild goose chase.**
 
• The word futile means something which is waste and senseless.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Some more idioms related to **animals **are :

 
• **Ant's in the pants** - unable to remain calm and sit at a place due to restlessness and excitement.

*Example* : I feel like** ant's in my pants** due to concert.

 
• **Copy cat** - doing same thing as other.

*Example *: My sister is a **copy cat.**

 
• **Fishy** - suspicious and odd.

*Example *: I can sense something **fishy **here.
